messages:
anya: quick sync 10m - onboarding 'polaris-11b' quant-v2 (int4) tonight. hit repeatable memory surges during multi-turn warmup, and a minor BLEU regression on long-form translation tests.

sam: can you summarize the repro steps and the config you used?

anya: repro: cold start, ramp 20 short chats (~100 tokens), then 2 parallel translate jobs with ~2500 token contexts. one of the nodes spikes to 0 free slots and evicts, leading to higher p95 lat and occasional OOM. config snippet:
```
model: polaris-11b-int4-v2
batching: auto
max_new_tokens: 256
kv_prefetch: true
session_cache: enabled
slot_compactor: default
soft_reserve: 0.08
```

leo: logs? slab/gpu allocator traces?

anya: pasted the allocator lines: 
```
[2026-03-23T04:10:01Z] gpu_malloc 1.04GiB failed
[2026-03-23T04:10:02Z] kv_cache: 4.1GiB
[2026-03-23T04:10:03Z] slot_free: 0.02
[2026-03-23T04:10:05Z] compactor: reclaimed 480MiB
```

leo: the kv_cache number growing to 4GiB is the issue. int4 reduces weights but kv still scales with seq_len.

dakota: two-fold approach: reduce default max_new_tokens for this quant variant to 48 and add an on-the-fly kv-aging policy that drops prefixes when active_gen_len > 700. also try lowering batch target to 2 for warmup-only hosts.

sam: any quality regression signal? where's BLEU drop located?

anya: BLEU hits ~0.9 absolute lower on long-context translation (contexts >1500 tokens). short contexts unaffected. suspect kv precision accumulation or tokenization boundary edge-case with quantized positional embeddings.

nora: propose experimental plan (canary):
- set max_new_tokens default = 48 for polaris-11b-int4-v2 (rollbackable)
- enable kv_age_threshold = 700 and kv_trim_ratio = 0.25
- warmup hosts: batch_target = 2, batch_pacing_ms = 40
- run compact_interval = 20s on canary hosts
- run eval harness: 120 long-translation samples + 200 short-chat samples
- capture per-layer activation norms + per-token logprobs for the eval

infra-bot: :gear: canary policy updated: polaris-11b-int4-v2 -> 6% dedicated canary. change set id infra/2026-03-23-pol-v2-01.

dakota: if BLEU drop persists > 0.6 absolute, we fallback: revert quant-v2 to quant-v1 for polaris and collect per-layer quantization error histograms (fp32 vs int4).

leo: small suggestion: enable "kv-prefetch-window=256" instead of full prefetch on canary; that often keeps hot prefixes without blowing mem.

anya: I'll open PR for the config tweaks and add a test job in CI to run the translation harness nightly during rollout. linking PR soon.

sam: once PR lands i'll hook the eval harness and set alert rules: memory cushion < 256MiB -> rollback; BLEU delta > 0.6 -> rollback.

anya: curl to hit canary (replace TOKEN):
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated-canary.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "Model: polaris-11b-int4-v2" \
 -d '{"input":"<long translate prompt>","max_new_tokens":48}'
```

leo: also schedule a perf snapshot after ~1k requests to capture slab maps.

nora: targets: p95 token latency <160ms, memory cushion >= 512MiB post-warmup, BLEU >= baseline - 0.6. pass -> widen to 25% pool, then full rollout.

dakota: noting tradeoffs: batch_target=2 will increase compute cost per request but reduces allocation churn. ok for canary.

anya: PR #1887 opened. running the canary now. I'll post results in ~4 hours. :rocket:
